name: cli-bridge
description: Let your agent call the Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLIs already installed and logged in on your own machine. Presets: Claude Opus 5.5 / Fable, Codex Astra / default. No API keys bundled; each CLI uses its own local login.

CLI_BRIDGE_CLAUDE_BIN.title: Claude CLI binary
CLI_BRIDGE_CLAUDE_BIN.description: Binary name or absolute path for Claude Code CLI. Default: claude

CLI_BRIDGE_CODEX_BIN.title: Codex CLI binary
CLI_BRIDGE_CODEX_BIN.description: Binary name or absolute path for OpenAI Codex CLI. Default: codex

CLI_BRIDGE_CLAUDE_DEFAULT_MODEL.title: Default Claude model
CLI_BRIDGE_CLAUDE_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Used when claude_prompt model=default. Default: claude-opus-5-5

CLI_BRIDGE_CODEX_DEFAULT_MODEL.title: Default Codex model (optional)
CLI_BRIDGE_CODEX_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Leave empty to use Codex CLI's own default when codex_prompt model=default.

CLI_BRIDGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT.title: Workspace root (allowed cwd)
CLI_BRIDGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT.description: Absolute path to the workspace folder the CLIs may run in. Empty = the folder the MCP host launched the server from.

CLI_BRIDGE_ALLOWED_ROOTS.title: Additional allowed roots (optional)
CLI_BRIDGE_ALLOWED_ROOTS.description: Optional os.pathsep-separated list of extra absolute folders the CLIs may run in, in addition to CLI_BRIDGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT. The cwd allowlist cannot be disabled; it can only be extended via CLI_BRIDGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT and this variable.

CLI_BRIDGE_OUTPUT_CAP_CHARS.title: Output cap characters
CLI_BRIDGE_OUTPUT_CAP_CHARS.description: Max stdout/stderr characters returned per call. Default: 20000
